result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, but I did not update the README and I could not run the built jar.

- **`Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. Added it to the no-argument usage overview next to `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: `run` sends both names to the same `updateLandscape` method, so options and behaviour are identical. With `-help`, `analyzeLandscape` prints its own usage and description, and `updateLandscape` prints its usage as before.

Verification: the offline `mvn -q -o -pl cli test -Dtest='Command*'` run finished with no errors, but I did not check which tests it ran. I rebuilt the CLI jar without tests. Running the jar to check the help output and an `analyzeLandscape` run needs your approval, which I was not given, so those are unchecked.

README: it has no command descriptions at all (only build and Docker sections, with no mention of landscape or any other command), so I left it unchanged. If you want a commands section added, tell me which commands it should list.
